title: Keep public /wc in parity with canonical main/wc
problem: The canonical worker bootstrap on main is PROMETEO UNIVERSAL COGNITIVE WORKER CANARY v3.5, but the published gh-pages wc/index.html and the public https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/wc/ entry still serve v3.3. The public shell correctly points workers to canonical main/wc, so workers that follow the instruction can recover, but the served first-hop contract itself lags mandatory pin-collision and surplus-discovery rules. This creates avoidable bootstrap divergence and makes the stable entry weaker than the canonical source it delegates to.
mission: Eliminate public /wc bootstrap drift by making the gh-pages entry a deterministic projection of canonical main/wc, or by adding an equivalent parity-enforced publication path, with a machine-checkable mismatch canary and no promotion of production /w.
acceptance: The public /wc entry and canonical main/wc expose the same active bootstrap version and mandatory allocation laws after publication.
A deterministic parity check detects version/content drift between main/wc and gh-pages wc/index.html before or immediately after publication.
Fresh workers following the public locator are never stranded on an older allocation/portfolio/discovery protocol when main/wc has advanced.
The repair remains canary-only and does not promote production /w, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.
evidence_refs: https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/wc/ observed serving v3.3 during this worker cycle
candidate_read_scope: publication/build scripts that project main coordination state to gh-pages
candidate_write_scope: gh-pages:wc/index.html or the exact generator/source that owns it
parity/canary test for canonical main/wc versus public /wc projection

risk.reason: The target is a canary bootstrap entry used by many fresh workers, so publication mistakes can amplify quickly. The repair should therefore preserve the canonical-link fallback and test exact parity before declaring success.

compounding_value.reason: Every fresh /wc worker begins at this public entry; removing first-hop drift reduces repeated context divergence and prevents older routing laws from surviving after canonical bootstrap changes.

goal_relevance.reason: Mass-launch workers should reconstruct one allocation contract from the stable locator rather than depend on whether they follow a second-hop canonical link correctly.

information_gain.reason: The exact mismatch is byte-addressable and reproducible: main v3.5 versus published/public v3.3.

regression_prevention.reason: A parity canary would turn silent bootstrap drift into a durable failure signal on future main/wc changes.

human_friction_reduction.reason: The human can continue launching identical chats with one stable locator without having to know which bootstrap version has propagated.

falsification: A current publication mechanism already deterministically projects main/wc to gh-pages and the observed v3.3 is only bounded propagation lag with an existing parity receipt.
A newer durable proposal/claim already owns the same root, target, problem class and acceptance outcome.
The public shell is intentionally version-stable by documented contract and all mandatory semantics are guaranteed solely by the canonical-link handoff.

source_freshness.observation: Canonical main/wc returned v3.5 while gh-pages wc/index.html and public /wc returned v3.3 in the same worker cycle.
